svg.title: Pending webhook delivery evidence
svg.desc: An explicit placeholder stating no real Discord or generic webhook delivery has been captured.
svg.text: EVIDENCE PENDING - NOT A DISCORD DELIVERY RESULT
A dry-notify payload preview is not an external delivery and is not shown as one.
Replace before submission only after a real configured sink succeeds:
- capture the destination message without exposing its webhook URL;
- match the run ID, priority card, and timestamp to its generated artifact;
- label zero deliveries or failed delivery truthfully when that is the actual outcome.
This asset contains no secret, real message, or claim of delivery.
